policy: unchanged structure / inputs / gate / position adapter / 3-file entry (sa_model.py identical); new adapter from the same seed and zero output
screens: the coverage study's 4 screens (S1 / S2 CE, M / P KL to the frozen base+head); the cache is recomputed the same way and must equal the coverage cache

objective.formula: loss = mean(CE_S1, CE_S2) + 1.0 * mean(KL_M, KL_P) + 1.0 * relative_retention
objective.relative_retention: mean over screens of mean over protected options of (delta(option) - delta(pass))^2; target 0 (= keeping each option-vs-pass logit difference of the frozen model)
objective.protected: S1: legal minus pass minus every option with the taught meaning (ディアクトロス②); S2: legal minus pass minus ファインメルト③; M / P: legal minus pass; pass = the snapshot Cancel checked against the NPZ legal row; illegal / padding never counted; no special rule for G (it is one of the untaught legal options where legal)

training.logged: CE, KL, relative term, each pre-clip gradient norm, combined norm, clip flag, update norm; before / after every legal option: frozen logit, delta, delta minus delta(pass), new margin, probability; protected max |relative delta|

target_threshold: training screens: the maximum |relative delta| over protected options <= 1.0 point (an experiment guide, not an acceptance criterion; a smaller original margin can still flip)

existing_conditions.reuse_rule: the new candidate is fed every own observation of the saved NPZ from the start (RNN reset, each once, position adapter on); reused only if EVERY own action index equals the recorded one, the record replayed exactly and its hashes are pinned; one differing action -> record + replay with the engine; reused results are referenced, not reported as new runs nor as independent samples
existing_conditions.C: the 13 retention cases are reused (no gated screen; frozen inference and gate unchanged)
existing_conditions.A: referenced from the corresponding reused / new B records (S1 / S2) after checking the pre-window inputs and 0 earlier activations

new_condition.name: H1-USAGI
new_condition.opponent: as in the unseen-response probe H1, but at the target the opponent activates 幽鬼うさぎ 59438930 (already in its fixed hand); other optional effects pass; same forced-choice rules; end at the first decision after the target chain resolved

usagi_script.reading: condition: the activating card is on the field and it is a monster effect (or a face-up S/T effect); cost: send itself to the GY; operation: DESTROY the activating card (no negation)

new_condition.not_established: if the effect is illegal or the target is not reached, recorded as such; no other hand is searched
new_condition.coverage_column: the coverage candidate only as an offline score computation on the BASE saved inputs, never as a played result

engine.plan: non-matching existing conditions record + replay (at most 24) + H1-USAGI 4 = at most 28; 2 spare for a harness fix only

items: 1. S1 / S2 improvements, the 2-cost 改変 O-M stop, M / P kept
3. ASH / GAMMA 4 screens and the new USAGI screen: G-vs-pass relative delta (also whether within 1.0); not fed back into training
4. untrained O-I responses and their results (e.g. 無限泡影 negated by ディアクトロス②) with resources; using an effect is not called an improvement
items_note: a same choice under a 33-35 margin is not counted as success; the relative-delta change is the main check
